Only methods declared in sugar-table/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

A table column with key, title, width, and optional style.

MethodSummary

withFlexibleWidth(int $share): self
withFlexWidth(int $share): selfAlias of withFlexibleWidth() under the Go flex-width name, so ports read 1:1. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.NewFlexColumn's flexFactor.
withMaxWidth(int $max): self
withFilterable(bool $v = true): self
withAlignLeft(bool $v = true): self
withStyle(string $ansiStyle): self

withWidthMode(ColumnWidth $mode, ?float $percent = null): selfThe single spelling for (re)declaring a column's width mechanism: mode plus, for Percent only, the percentage. A non-Percent mode discards any stale percent — the ghost value that used to survive some withers and die in others; the resolver gates percent reads on the mode, so what is stored for other modes could never be honoured, only forgotten silently.
withWrapMode(WrapMode $wrapMode): self
withSortType(SortType $type): selfChoose how this column's values compare under Table::sortBy() (OG-5 / ST-36). Auto (default) is float-when-both-numeric else case-insensitive text; Natural orders digit runs numerically ("item2" < "item10"). Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.Column.WithSortType.
withSortFunc(?callable $fn): selfPer-column comparator hook; null restores $sortType. The callable gets the two cells' raw values (a StyledCell is unwrapped to its value) and returns <0, 0 or >0 in ascending sense — Table flips it for descending.
withFormatString(string $format): selfsprintf template for the displayed value ('%.2f', '$%s'); '' clears it. Display only — sort, filter and search keep reading the raw value. An invalid template throws here, not mid-render. Missing (null) values show the table's missing indicator unformatted. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.Column.WithFormatString.
static clipToWidth(string $text, int $width): stringClamp one line of text to a display-width budget, announcing the cut with '…' (U+2026, 1 cell) so truncated content is never silent.
static splitClusters(string $text): arraySplit text into clusters for character-level wrapping and width fitting.

Table final class

MethodSummary
static fromColumns(array $columns): self
withRows(array $rows): selfReplace the whole row set in ONE bulk copy.
toggleChecked(?int $viewIndex = null): selfToggle the multi-row selection (checked set) of the row under the cursor, or of the row at $viewIndex in the page-global filtered/sorted view (OG-5 / ST-38). This is the SET upstream keeps in Row.Selected; the single cursor (selectNext()/selectedRow()) is independent of it. Hosts bind it to space. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table's space-toggle of Row.Selected.
withRowChecked(Row $row, bool $checked = true): selfSet one Row's checked state explicitly; a Row not in the table throws.
withAllRowsChecked(): selfCheck every row of the filtered/sorted view (all pages).
withAllRowsUnchecked(): selfClear the checked set. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithAllRowsDeselected.
checked(Row $row): bool
checkedRows(): arrayThe checked rows in view order (rows filtered out of the view are excluded but stay checked). Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.SelectedRows.
withCheckMarks(string $unchecked = '[ ]', string $checked = '[x]'): selfShow a checkbox gutter before the first column: $unchecked / $checked are the per-row marks (default '[ ]' / '[x]'). The gutter is the wider mark plus one gap cell and sits OUTSIDE withWidth()'s column span. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithSelectedText.
withoutCheckMarks(): selfRemove the checkbox gutter (the checked set itself is kept).
withColumns(array $columns): selfReplace all columns with a new set.
withBaseStyle(string $ansiStyle): self
withMissingIndicator(string|StyledCell $s): selfSet the placeholder that paints any cell whose value is missing (raw null or StyledCell(null) — one no-value law).
withBorderStyle(string $ansiStyle): selfApply an ANSI SGR style string to the default border (e.g. "1;32" for bold green).
withSelectable(bool $v = true): self
withPageSize(int $n): selfRows per page. $n <= 0 disables pagination entirely — the whole view renders as one frame and the footer disappears (the negative value is stored verbatim; every page read is gated on > 0, so it behaves as off). Positive sizes re-anchor the current page and cursor via gotoPage(). Policy pointer: README "Numeric setters: coercion vs throw".
withPage(int $n): selfNavigate to a page, clamped to the valid range, and park the cursor on that page's first row (audit finding #9: an out-of-range page used to leak — a negative page made array_slice count from the END).
withFrozenCols(array $indices): selfPin columns by index so they remain visible during horizontal scroll.
withFrozenKeys(array $keys): selfKey-addressed companion of self::withFrozenCols(): resolves each key to its original column index — unknown keys throw naming the key — then applies the identical contiguous-prefix law.
withScrollX(int $offset): selfSet the horizontal scroll offset for non-frozen columns.
withViewportHeight(int $height): selfVisible-row window for viewport virtualization. Negatives clamp to 0 and 0 means virtualization off (all rows render) — coercion, not throw, per README "Numeric setters: coercion vs throw".
withMaxLines(int $lines): selfLine budget for the data region (OG-3 / ST-20). withViewportHeight() counts ROWS, so under WordWrap a 2-row viewport can paint nine lines; a line-budgeted host sets this instead (or as well): whole rows are kept while their cumulative height fits $lines, the rest are truncated, never split. At least one row always renders, and a row that would be cut off while it is the cursor row pulls the window forward so the highlight stays on-screen. 0 (default) = no budget; negatives clamp to 0. Header, footer and borders sit outside it. Mirrors evertras/bubble-table WithTargetHeight (line-based paging).
maxLines(): int
renderedLineCount(): intTotal lines the current frame paints (border, header, data rows at their wrapped heights, footer) — 0 when nothing renders. Lets a line-budgeted host size the surrounding layout without parsing view() output.
withScrollY(int $offset): self
scrollY(): int
withZebra(bool $v = true): self
withZebraStyleEven(string|Style|\SugarCraft\Style\Style $style): selfStyle of the EVEN zebra stripe (default black on light-gray, '30;47'). Accepts the same shapes as the styleFunc funnel: an SGR string, a CellBuffer Style or a declarative SugarCraft\Style\Style. An empty string clears the stripe.
withZebraStyleOdd(string|Style|\SugarCraft\Style\Style $style): selfStyle of the ODD zebra stripe (default none); see withZebraStyleEven().
withHeaderStyle(string $s): self
withShowHeader(bool $v): self
withShowFooter(bool $v): self
withFooterType(FooterType $type): selfSet the footer display type.
withBorder(Border $border): selfSet the border character family for the table.
withMultilineMode(bool $multiline = true): selfToggle multi-line row rendering.
withStyleFunc(?callable $fn): selfSet a per-cell style callback.
withCellPadding(int $padding): selfSet inner cell padding.
withMarkedFrameSanitization(bool $v = true): selfRoute every content/header ingress through the marked-frame policy (strict Private-Use sweep). Residual host duty: values that never pass through a table ingress — styleFunc-returned SGR strings, configured border glyphs and the missing-value indicator — remain host-controlled and are NOT swept by this flag.
withBorderless(bool $v = true): self
withWidth(int $cols): selfPin the total render width (in cells). Flex columns fill exactly the room left after Fixed/Percent columns and the inter-column gaps, so every line renders to exactly $cols cells. 0 restores the natural (column-derived) width.
withHiddenCols(array $indices): selfHide columns by index without removing them from the table.
withStrictPercent(bool $v = true): selfOpt-in strict percent budgeting (OG-9 arm B / ST-61): with it on, a VISIBLE Percent set summing past 100 throws InvalidArgumentException when it is configured (here, withColumns(), withHiddenCols()) instead of being scaled down at solve time (the default, arm A: over-subscribed percents are normalised so the set never exceeds the table width). Applies to the columns the table already holds.
withHiddenKeys(array $keys): selfKey-addressed companion of self::withHiddenCols(): resolves each key to its original column index — unknown keys throw naming the key — then applies the identical validation.
withExpandedRows(array $indices): selfSet which rows are expanded on the current page.
toggleExpanded(int $rowIndex): selfToggle the expanded state of a row on the current page.
isExpanded(int $rowIndex): boolCheck if a row on the current page is currently expanded.
addRow(Row $row): selfAppend ONE row: each call is an immutable copy of the row set, so building N rows by looping this method is O(N²) copies — load bulk with withRows() or addRows().
addRows(array $rows): selfAppend rows in ONE bulk copy (the counterpart to the single-add quadratic above; see withRows() for the replace-all form).
selectNext(): self
selectPrevious(): self
withSelectedIndex(int $index): selfMove the selection directly to a 0-based index in the PAGE-GLOBAL filtered/sorted view, clamped to it, and auto-page so the cursor stays visible (page = intdiv(index, pageSize)) — exactly what a caller tracking its own cursor needs. Mirrors Bubbles' table.SetCursor, which likewise scrolls the viewport to reveal the cursor.
selectPage(int $page): selfJump to a page and park the cursor on its first row. Same semantics as withPage() — both route through the single page-navigation path.
nextPage(): self
previousPage(): self
withPaginationWrap(bool $v = true): selfCycle instead of clamp (OG-5 / ST-68): with wrapping on, selectNext() past the last row lands on the first, selectPrevious() before the first lands on the last, and nextPage()/previousPage() cycle the page ring. Default off — the port clamps. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithPaginationWrapping.
withMaxTotalWidth(int $cells): selfCap the content span (columns plus gaps, excluding the outer border) at $cells and window the scrollable columns to what fits, measured on declared widths; the rest sit off-screen until scrollRight(). Frozen columns always stay and one scrollable column is always kept. 0 (default) = no cap. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithMaxTotalWidth.
withOverflowArrows(bool $v = true): selfMark horizontal overflow in the header (OG-5 / ST-70): '«' leads the first scrolled header cell while columns are scrolled off on the left, '»' ends the last one while withMaxTotalWidth() cuts columns on the right. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table's header overflow arrows.
scrollX(): int
scrollLeft(): selfPan one scrollable column left; clamps at 0.
scrollRight(): selfPan one scrollable column right; stops once the last column is the window's first (never scrolls past the data) and, with withMaxTotalWidth(), once nothing overflows on the right any more.
withRowSeparator(bool $v = true): selfDraw a horizontal rule between data rows (OG-5 / ST-71), the same rule the header uses, never after the last row. Off by default. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table's per-row separator lines.
withStaticFooter(string $text): selfFixed footer text (OG-5 / ST-69) replacing the Page/Rows label. It is shown whenever the footer is shown, paginated or not; '' (default) restores the pagination footer. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithStaticFooter.
scrollYForKey(string|KeyEvent $key): intReturn the new scrollY value for a given keyboard key.
handleScrollKey(string|KeyEvent $key): selfReturn a new Table with scrollY adjusted for the given keyboard key.
handleKey(string|KeyEvent $key): selfDelegating alias of handleScrollKey(), kept because the old name promised navigation while only ever scrolling.
maxScrollY(): intThe largest scrollY the current view can show.
sortBy(string $colKey, bool $ascending = true, bool $primary = true): selfSort by $colKey. If already sorting by it, toggle asc/desc. If $primary is true, replace existing sort list; otherwise append.
clearSort(): self
filter(string $colKey, string $text): self
clearFilter(string $colKey): self
clearAllFilters(): self
search(string $text): selfGlobal full-text search (case-insensitive).
withFilterFunc(?callable $fn): selfReplace the global search's substring match with a host predicate (OG-5 / ST-37): fn(Row $row, string $searchText): bool, called once per row while search() text is non-empty; true keeps the row. Column filters (filter()) keep their substring rule and still AND with it. null restores the built-in match. Fuzzy matching is a predicate away (e.g. over sugar-fuzzy) rather than a built-in. Mirrors Evertras/bubble-table.WithFilterFunc.
clearSearch(): selfClear the global search.
columns(): array
column(string $key): ?ColumnReturn the column with the given key, or null if not found.
rows(): array
filteredSortedRows(): array
pagedRows(): array
currentRow(): ?RowThe selected row in the PAGE-GLOBAL filtered/sorted view (audit #5: it used to index the page-local slice while withSelectedIndex clamped globally — a cursor past page 0 read null). The page follows the cursor via withSelectedIndex()/gotoPage().
currentRowData(): ?RowData

currentPage(): int

sortColumns(): arrayActive sort stack in priority order: the first entry is the primary key, later entries tie-break it (the state sortBy() and clearSort() mutate was write-only; hosts re-tracked it blind).
activeFilters(): arrayActive per-column filter texts, keyed by column key (the state filter()/clearFilter() mutate; an empty map means unfiltered).
searchText(): stringActive global search needle ('' when unset).
totalWidth(): intTotal rendered width of the table in columns (pinned width when set, else the solved content widths plus inter-column borders) — the pre-render budget readout candy-sql hand-computes today (audit finding 075; cross-lib note is report-only, out of group).
pageFooter(): string
rowsFooter(): stringReturn a "Showing X to Y of Z rows" footer string.
